selection_criteria.big_national_banks: Institutions were screened against FDIC BankFind total assets. Every institution listed is among the largest 90 active FDIC-insured banks in the country (assets from $56.8B to $4.09T). Eleven of the sixteen institutions are national banks (BKCLASS = N); the other five are a state member bank, a state nonmember bank, a savings bank, and the two state-member online banks, all FDIC-insured. No small local bank, credit union, fintech front-end, or brokerage sweep program is included.
selection_criteria.digital_app: A mobile app claim is recorded only where the bank's own account page or app page names the app. Otherwise the column is left blank and flagged.
selection_criteria.fdic: Every institution is confirmed ACTIVE = 1 and INSFDIC = 1 in the FDIC BankFind API on 2026-10-22. Coverage limits come from FDIC.gov.
selection_criteria.rates: APY values are transcribed exactly from the bank's own page and carry the bank's own effective date. Rates that are only shown after ZIP entry, or that render as a template placeholder, are left blank and flagged instead of estimated.
